description: This file contains a Roslyn analyzer that checks C# interface definitions for properties in interfaces that inherit from a specific base interface, 'Orleans.Runtime.IAddressable'. It reports diagnostics if properties are found in such interfaces.

classes.name: GrainInterfacePropertyDiagnosticAnalyzer
classes.description: A Roslyn diagnostic analyzer that enforces rules against properties in interfaces that inherit from 'Orleans.Runtime.IAddressable'.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up analysis configuration and registers syntax node actions for property declarations.

methods.name: AnalyzeSyntax
methods.description: Analyzes property declaration syntax nodes, checking whether properties are in interfaces that inherit from the specified base interface and reports diagnostics accordingly.
